text.title: He put my $90 cashmere sweater in the dryer and says 'it's just a little smaller now'. Who's right?
text.story: It fits our 8 year old niece now.

text.title: My husband says I'm not allowed to be mad that he forgot my birthday because 'you never remind me'. Ok who's right?
text.story: It's on his phone calendar. I checked.

text.title: He wants to go to his buddy's bachelor party in Cabo the same week I'm due. Who's right here?
text.story: He says first babies are always late.

text.title: I want to tell my best friend before his family that we're engaged. He thinks parents first. Who is right?
text.story: My best friend introduced us lol

text.title: My bf eats the last of everything and doesn't put it on the list. I think that's a crime. Who's right??
text.story: Opened the fridge for creamer this morning. Empty carton. Back in the fridge.

text.title: He says it's 'basically the same' to text me happy anniversary from the golf course. Who's right?
text.story: He booked the tee time 3 weeks ago. He knew.

text.title: My husband leaves exactly 1 square of toilet paper on the roll so he 'doesn't have to change it'. So who's right?
text.story: He thinks it's hilarious. It's been 4 years.

text.title: Fiancé wants his mom to help pick my wedding dress. I want my mom and my sister only. Who's right?
text.story: His mom has already sent me 11 links.

text.title: He thinks it's fine to have his female coworker over to 'study' for a certification while I'm at work. Who's right here?
text.story: They passed. I'm still mad.

text.title: I told his mom she can't post our ultrasound on Facebook. He says I embarrassed her. Which one of us is right?
text.story: She already had it typed up with 4 paragraphs.

text.title: My boyfriend says if I'm cold I should 'just wear a hoodie' instead of turning up the heat. Ok who's right?
text.story: I'm wearing two hoodies. It's 64 in here.

text.title: He spent our weekend away fixing his friend's car. I spent it alone at a B&B. Who's right?
text.story: The car was 'basically an emergency'. It was a hobby car.

text.title: My husband wants a tv in the bedroom. I say no screens in the bedroom, ever. Who's right??
text.story: He fell asleep to SportsCenter for 6 years before me.

text.title: I asked for help with the kids' bath and he said 'you're better at it'. Who's actually right?
text.story: I'm better at it because I'm the only one who does it.

text.title: He gave my car keys to his brother without asking because 'it's family'. Who's right?
text.story: His brother returned it with no gas and a drive-thru bag.

text.title: My fiancé wants a 'cheap' wedding ring for himself so he can spend more on his golf clubs. Who's right here?
text.story: He's spending $1,400 on clubs and $40 on a ring.

text.title: I want my maiden name as our daughter's middle name. He wants his grandma's name. Who is right?
text.story: His grandma already has 3 namesakes in the family.

text.title: He says it's 'not a big deal' that he told his ex about our engagement before I told my parents. Who's right?
text.story: They're 'friends' now. I found out from her Instagram comment.

text.title: Boyfriend wants to bring his dog on our first vacation together. I want a dog-free beach week. Who's right?
text.story: The dog sleeps in our bed and snores.

text.title: My husband makes me drive home from every party so he can drink. Every single time. Who's actually right?
text.story: I like wine too, Brian.

text.title: My wife reorganized my garage while I was at work and now I can't find anything. Who's right?
text.story: She labeled everything. I just liked my piles.

text.title: She wants me to shave my beard for our wedding. I've had it for 9 years. Who's right?
text.story: She's literally never seen my chin.

text.title: My girlfriend says playing video games with my brother on our date night counts as 'ditching her'. Who is right?
text.story: It was one round. Ok it was four.

text.title: My wife wants to repaint our kitchen for the 3rd time in 2 years. I say it's fine. Who's right here?
text.story: It's currently 'sage'. Before that 'other sage'.

text.title: My fiancée wants a prenup because her parents told her to. I'm hurt. Which one of us is right?
text.story: I make more money than her. I'm the one who should worry lol

text.title: He thinks I should let his 19 year old cousin live with us for the summer 'rent free'. Who's right?
text.story: We have a one bedroom and a pullout couch.

text.title: I posted a pic of us and he asked me to take it down because he 'doesn't like his face in it'. Who's right?
text.story: He looked fine. He just didn't want it up.

text.title: My husband has a password on his phone now. He never did before. Do I ask?
text.story: Started 2 weeks ago. Says it's for 'work security'.

text.title: His ex sent our baby a $200 gift. He wants to keep it. Do we?
text.story: She has never met me. Or the baby.

text.title: Found out my bf has been sending his ex memes every day for a year. Cheating or nah?
text.story: No flirting, just memes. Every. Day.

text.title: He 'forgot' to take his ring off when he went to the bar but somehow came home without it. Am I overreacting?
text.story: He says it fell off playing pool. It's at the bottom of his gym bag.

text.title: My boyfriend follows 400 girls on Instagram and 30 guys. Red flag or normal?
text.story: Most of them are bikini models from Miami.

text.title: My husband went to a strip club for his friend's bachelor party. Do I care?
text.story: He told me before he went. Said he didn't get a dance.

text.title: Found Tinder on my bf's laptop. He says it's from before we met. Last login was Tuesday.
text.story: We've been together 14 months.

text.title: My ex DMed me 'you look happy' under a pic with my new bf. Answer or ignore?
text.story: We broke up 2 years ago. He was the one who left.

text.title: My husband's best friend's wife flirts with him right in front of me. Say something to her or to him?
text.story: Last time she sat on his lap 'as a joke'.

text.title: He still has a folder of his ex's nudes on an old hard drive. Make him delete it?
text.story: He says he 'forgot it was there'. It's labeled.

text.title: My bf gets a 'good morning beautiful' text from a coworker every day. He says she does it to everyone.
text.story: I asked her husband. She does not do it to everyone.

text.title: Is it cheating if he kissed someone the week we 'took a break'?
text.story: The break was 6 days. He was the one who asked for it.

text.title: I found out my fiancé still pays for his ex's Netflix. Is that a big deal?
text.story: They broke up in 2021. He 'forgot'.

text.title: My husband went to dinner with his ex 'to get closure'. 11 years later. Ok?
text.story: He told me after. They split dessert.

text.title: My girlfriend still sleeps in her ex's hoodie. She says it's just comfy. Weird or fine?
text.story: It still says his last name on the back.

text.title: My wife's ex lives across the street from her parents. She goes over to 'say hi' every visit. Do I say something?
text.story: Every visit. 20 minutes minimum.

text.title: My boyfriend has a girl best friend who calls him 'babe'. Normal?
text.story: She calls everyone babe apparently. Including her dentist.

text.title: Caught him liking a girl's comment that said 'call me when you're single'. Big deal?
text.story: He says he didn't read it before he liked it.

text.title: My husband's coworker sends him songs on Spotify. Love songs. Am I crazy?
text.story: He says she sends songs to the whole team.

text.title: He tells random girls at bars that he's single 'so they leave him alone faster'. Make it make sense.
text.story: His logic: if he says he has a girlfriend they ask questions.

text.title: Would you want to know if your partner cheated once 5 years ago and never again?
text.story: Asking for a friend. The friend is me.

text.title: My ex's mom still texts me happy birthday every year. Should I tell her to stop?
text.story: Her son cheated on me. She's lovely though.

text.title: Is it weird that my boyfriend still has his ex's last name in his phone as 'Wifey'?
text.story: They were never married. Contact has a heart emoji.

text.title: Found out my husband kept his wedding ring from his first marriage. In his sock drawer. Ok or not?
text.story: Says he might 'sell it for gold someday'.

text.title: Is liking an old pic of your ex from 2017 at 1am an accident or a cry for help?
text.story: My bf did it. Says he was 'just scrolling'.

text.title: He showed up to our first date with his roommate. 'He's new in town.' Stay or leave?
text.story: The roommate ordered appetizers for the table.

text.title: Guy on Hinge asked for my Venmo 'to see if I'm real'. Normal or scam?
text.story: He was cute but now I'm scared.

text.title: He said he's 6'0 on his profile. He's 5'8 in person. Dealbreaker?
text.story: Everything else about him was great.

text.title: 2nd date, he asked to split the bill and then asked for my leftovers. Third date or no?
text.story: He took them home. Pad thai. Mine.

text.title: He planned our first date at his apartment and said he'd cook. Cute or red flag?
text.story: We've only been talking for 4 days.

text.title: I'm 28 and he's 41. Too big an age gap?
text.story: He's kind, has his life together, and makes me laugh.

text.title: Bumble guy unmatched me mid conversation then rematched a week later like nothing happened. Answer him?
text.story: His opener: 'hey stranger'.

text.title: Matched with my ex's brother on Hinge. Swipe right or no?
text.story: My ex and I dated 6 years ago. His brother is honestly cuter.

text.title: First date, he talked about his ex for 40 minutes. Second chance?
text.story: He did apologize. In the car. After.

text.title: He double texts. A lot. Like 9 texts in a row. Cute or exhausting?
text.story: Mostly memes and 'wyd'.

text.title: My date ordered for me without asking. Old school romantic or controlling?
text.story: He got it right though lol

text.title: Guy I've been seeing 3 weeks wants me to meet his parents this weekend. Too soon?
text.story: He's 34 and says he 'knows what he wants'.

text.title: He said 'I don't really read' on our first date. Dealbreaker?
text.story: I read like 40 books a year.

text.title: First kiss happened in a Chick-fil-A parking lot. Romantic or tragic?
text.story: He had a sweet tea in his other hand.

text.title: Matched with a guy who's still in his wedding photos on his profile. 'They're good pictures.' Swipe?
text.story: He's divorced. The bride is cropped. Badly.

text.title: She asked me to pay for her Uber home after our first date. 45 min ride. Do I?
text.story: Date was fine. I paid for dinner too.

text.title: Second date and she brought up what our kids would be named. Run or roll with it?
text.story: She was half joking. Maybe a third joking.

text.title: I'm 5'7. Should I put my height on Hinge or let her see in person?
text.story: Every guy online is apparently 6'1.

text.title: He sent me a voice memo instead of texting back. 4 minutes long. Romantic or a lot?
text.story: He was walking his dog and just talking about his day.

text.title: My Hinge 'Together we could' prompt. Which one?
text.story: I'm a nurse who works 3 nights a week.
text.a: Order takeout and judge strangers' dogs
text.b: Get up early for once and regret it

text.title: Third date and he still hasn't asked me a single question about myself. Give up?
text.story: I know his whole fantasy football roster now.

text.title: He's broke but sweet. I make 3x what he makes. Keep dating?
text.story: He's a teacher. He picks me up flowers from Trader Joe's.

text.title: My future SIL wants to wear white to my wedding 'because it's her color'. Allow it?
text.story: She showed me the dress. It's literally a gown.

text.title: Fiancé proposed with his grandma's ring. I don't love it. Tell him?
text.story: It's beautiful, just not my style. It's very yellow gold.

text.title: My bridesmaid just told me she's pregnant and due the week of my wedding. Still keep her in?
text.story: She's my best friend since 4th grade.

text.title: Is it tacky to have a GoFundMe for our honeymoon?
text.story: We're paying for the wedding ourselves.

text.title: He proposed at my sister's birthday dinner. In front of everyone. Sweet or rude to her?
text.story: She smiled but she left early.

text.title: My MOH wants to charge everyone $350 for a spa day I never asked for. Shut it down?
text.story: Two of my bridesmaids are in college.

text.title: Is it weird to invite my ex to my wedding if we're genuinely friends now?
text.story: He's dating my cousin. It's a long story.

text.title: Cash bar or limited open bar (beer and wine only)?
text.story: 120 guests. Midwest wedding. My uncles WILL complain.

text.title: My dad wants to give a speech. He cries at commercials. Let him?
text.story: Last speech he gave was at my grandpa's funeral and he sang.

text.title: My fiancé wants his groomsmen in matching Crocs for the 'fun pics'. Allow it?
text.story: They're black. He says they're 'formal Crocs'.

text.title: No-phones wedding: tacky or genius?
text.story: I've seen too many aisle pics with 40 iPhones in them.

text.title: I'm the bride and my sister wants to announce her engagement at my rehearsal dinner. Ok?
text.story: She asked first at least.

text.title: Bachelorette budget: is $1,200 too much to ask bridesmaids for a 3 day trip?
text.story: Flights not included. It's in Scottsdale.

text.title: Proposal: private or in front of family and friends?
text.story: He's asking my opinion 'hypothetically'. He's terrible at secrets.

text.title: I want to propose at a Lakers game on the jumbotron. My sister says she'll hate it. Who's right?
text.story: She's been to 3 games with me. She seemed fine.

text.title: Ring budget: is 3 months salary still a thing?
text.story: I make $70k. Ring I like is $11k.

text.title: My friend asked me to be a bridesmaid via a TikTok trend. Do I say yes just because?
text.story: We haven't really talked in 2 years.

text.title: Do I invite my dad's girlfriend to my wedding? They've been together 8 months.
text.story: My mom will be there. Just saying.

text.title: Kids at the wedding: yes or no?
text.story: My sister has 3 under 5. She WILL bring them either way.

text.title: My MIL booked her hair and makeup with MY artist without asking. Say something?
text.story: Now there's no time slot for my flower girl.

text.title: Wedding on a Friday to save $8k. Tacky or smart?
text.story: Half the guests would need to take a day off.

text.title: Is it rude to have a registry with only cash funds?
text.story: We already have a toaster. Two actually.

text.title: My fiancé wants our first dance to be a choreographed TikTok routine. Yes or no?
text.story: He's been practicing secretly. His brother told me.

text.title: Do I tell my bridesmaid her new boyfriend can't come since we've never met him?
text.story: They've been dating 3 weeks. He's 'very serious' apparently.

text.title: My 4 year old called my MIL 'the mean grandma'. In front of her. Do I make him apologize?
text.story: He's... not wrong.

text.title: Husband lets our 6 year old play Fortnite. I say not till 10. Who's right?
text.story: All his friends play it. All of them.

text.title: My kid's teacher emails me at 9pm about 'behavior'. Every week. Answer that night or wait?
text.story: It was about him singing too loudly at lunch.

text.title: Should I pay my 12 year old for good grades?
text.story: $5 per A. My husband says that's bribery.

text.title: Is it ok to tell other parents their kid can't come over anymore?
text.story: Every time he comes over something gets broken.

text.title: Our nanny posted my kids on her Instagram without asking. Fire her?
text.story: She's amazing otherwise. Kids love her.

text.title: My mom gives my kids soda every time she babysits. Stop asking her to babysit?
text.story: She's free. Daycare is $85 a day.

text.title: Sleepovers at 8: yes or no?
text.story: My daughter's friend invited her. I don't know the parents well.

text.title: My husband wants to let our toddler cry it out. I can't do it. Who's right?
text.story: We haven't slept more than 4 hours since March.

text.title: My wife wants to homeschool. I think the kids need real school friends. Who's right?
text.story: Our oldest is 6. She's a teacher.

text.title: Do I tell my sister her kid is the reason nobody wants playdates?
text.story: He bites. He's 6. She says it's 'a phase'.

text.title: Kid gets a phone at what age?
text.story: My 9 year old says she's 'the only one without one'. Again.

text.title: Do I let my 15 year old daughter date?
text.story: He's 16, seems sweet, his mom is my coworker.

text.title: My bf makes $140k and wants me to pay half on everything. I make $48k. Fair?
text.story: He also wants to split groceries he mostly eats.

text.title: My friend borrowed $600 for rent 8 months ago. She just posted from Mexico. Say something?
text.story: She's 'been meaning to pay me back'.

text.title: Joint bank account after marriage or keep separate?
text.story: My parents always had one account. His never did.

text.title: My coworker takes credit for my work in every meeting. Call her out or go to my boss?
text.story: She did it again today. With my slides.

text.title: Got offered a $20k raise to move to an office with a 90 minute commute. Take it?
text.story: I currently work from home 3 days a week.

text.title: My husband lent his brother $8k without asking me. Big deal?
text.story: We have $14k in savings total.

text.title: Is it ok to ask for a raise 6 months into a new job?
text.story: I'm doing the work of 2 people since a guy quit.

text.title: My boss texts me on weekends. Answer or wait till Monday?
text.story: It's usually 'quick question' and it's never quick.

text.title: Friend group trip to Mexico, I'm the only one with a budget. Go or skip?
text.story: Everyone else makes double what I do. They want a $500/night villa.

text.title: He wants me to pay off my student loans before we get married. Fair?
text.story: I have $38k left. He has none.

text.title: Would you take a job you'd hate for $30k more?
text.story: $62k now, love it. $92k offer at a bank.

text.title: Is it rude to bring Tupperware to a work potluck and take leftovers home?
text.story: There's always tons left and it all gets thrown out.

text.title: My wife wants to quit her job and start a candle business. Support it or say wait?
text.story: We have a baby and one income would be tight.

text.title: Do I tell my coworker she's making $12k less than the new guy?
text.story: I'm on the hiring committee. I'm not supposed to know.

text.title: Fiancé wants to put the wedding on credit cards. Do it or postpone?
text.story: We'd owe $26k at 24%.

text.title: Girls dinner: I don't drink. Split the $480 bill evenly?
text.story: I had a $22 pasta and sparkling water.

text.title: Got a job offer from my ex's company. Same floor. Take it?
text.story: $18k more than I make now.

text.title: My mom wants $500 a month for watching my son 3 days a week. Fair?
text.story: Daycare would be $1,400.

text.title: Boss asked me to train my replacement before telling me I'm being laid off. Do I do it?
text.story: I figured it out from a calendar invite.

text.title: Is it tacky to ask guests to pay for their own dinner at my 30th?
text.story: It's at a steakhouse I can't afford for 14 people.

text.title: My roommate's boyfriend has basically moved in. He showers here every day and pays nothing. Who's right, me or her?
text.story: She says he 'buys groceries sometimes'. He bought oat milk once.

text.title: My best friend didn't come to my baby shower because she 'had a hair appointment'. Let it go?
text.story: We've been friends since 7th grade.

text.title: My sister named her baby the name I've been saving since I was 12. She knew. Am I allowed to be mad?
text.story: She says 'you weren't even pregnant'.

text.title: My MIL keeps 'accidentally' calling me by his ex's name. 3 times this month. Do I say something?
text.story: His ex was around for 9 years. I've been here for 4.

text.title: My buddy wants me to lie to his girlfriend about where he was Saturday night. Do I?
text.story: He swears nothing happened. He was at a casino.

text.title: My friend only ever texts me when she needs a ride to the airport. Keep driving her?
text.story: 4 times this year. Never once offered gas money.

text.title: My husband's family does Christmas presents for the kids only. My family does everyone. Which way do we do it at our house?
text.story: Hosting both families for the first time.

text.title: My dad remarried and his new wife wants my kids to call her Grandma. Ok or too soon?
text.story: They've been married 5 months. She's 44.

text.title: Friend got engaged and posted before calling me. I'm supposed to be her maid of honor. Overreacting?
text.story: I found out from her Instagram story like everyone else.

text.title: My roommate eats my leftovers and leaves a sticky note that says 'sorry!! I'll replace it'. She never does. Who's right?
text.story: It happened with my birthday cake.

text.title: My brother asked me to be his best man, but I haven't talked to him in 2 years. Say yes?
text.story: We had a big fight about our dad's house.

text.title: My fiancé's best friend is a girl and she wants to be in his groomsman lineup. Ok?
text.story: She'd wear a suit. I'd honestly kind of love it.

text.title: He wants a vasectomy. I'm not sure I'm done having kids. Who gets the final say?
text.story: We have 2. I'm 31.

text.title: My boyfriend wants us to share one phone charger 'to save space'. Romantic or insane?
text.story: It's on HIS side of the bed.

text.title: My girlfriend wants to split the Christmas we spend with each family by hours, not days. Who's right?
text.story: She made a spreadsheet. With colors.

text.title: My husband went to Costco and came back with a $1,900 grill. We said we'd save this year. Who's right?
text.story: He says it was 'on sale'.

text.title: He thinks we should skip anniversary gifts and 'just enjoy each other'. I love gifts. Who's right?
text.story: Love language: gifts. His: Netflix.

text.title: Hinge guy asked me to send a 'quick selfie' to prove I look like my pics. Do I?
text.story: We've been texting 4 days. He's sent zero pics himself.

text.title: He paid for dinner and then said 'you can get dessert'. Dessert was $11. Fair split?
text.story: Dinner was $96.

photo.title: Found two ring tabs open on his laptop. Which one do I 'accidentally' say I love?
photo.story: He has no idea I saw. 4 years together.

photo.title: Moving in together and there's room for ONE couch. Mine or his? Who's right?
photo.story: His has been in 3 apartments and a frat house.

photo.title: Adopting this weekend. He wants the big guy, I want the shy one. Who's right?
photo.story: The shy one hid behind the water bowl the whole visit.

photo.title: Wedding venue: $9k barn or my parents' backyard for free?
photo.story: Free comes with my dad running the grill AND the playlist.

photo.title: Baby #2 in April. I want the minivan, he wants the SUV. Who's right?
photo.story: He says minivans are 'giving up'. I say sliding doors.

photo.title: Second date, he picked a wine bar. Which one?
photo.story: First date was coffee so he hasn't seen me dressed up.

photo.title: Proposing next month. Beach at sunset or the dive bar where we met?
photo.story: She'd cry at both. She'd laugh at the bar.

photo.title: Two matches asked me out for Friday. Fish pic guy or gym selfie guy?
photo.story: Fish guy is funnier over text. Gym guy actually makes plans.

photo.title: Bride gave us 24 hours to vote. Sage or blush?
photo.story: There are 6 of us and we're all different skin tones.

photo.title: He wants the big wedding cake. I want a sheet cake and the $900 back. Who's right?
photo.story: Nobody remembers the cake. Everyone remembers the open bar.

photo.title: Engagement photos: city rooftop or a wildflower field?
photo.story: He's from Chicago, I grew up on a farm.

photo.title: Painting the nursery. Sage green or soft yellow?
photo.story: Gender reveal is next week but I want to paint now.

photo.title: Matching tattoos with my sister. Tiny hearts or our mom's handwriting?
photo.story: Mom passed 2 years ago. We have a birthday card from her.

photo.title: Starting a new job Monday. Keep it long or finally get the bob?
photo.story: I've had the same hair since high school.

photo.title: Wedding hair: up or down?
photo.story: Outdoor ceremony in June. It will be windy.

photo.title: He wants a hot tub. I want a pool. We can afford one. Who's right?
photo.story: We live in Ohio. He says that's his whole point.

photo.title: Real tree or fake tree? He says real trees are 'a fire waiting to happen'.
photo.story: I grew up going to the tree farm every year.

photo.title: First dog in a 1 bedroom apartment. Frenchie or a rescue mutt?
photo.story: My bf is set on a Frenchie. I've seen what they cost.

photo.title: Bridesmaid gifts: robes or tote bags?
photo.story: 7 bridesmaids, about $40 each.

photo.title: Bachelorette outfits for night two. All pink or all black?
photo.story: Night one is cowboy hats. Don't ask.

photo.title: Date night idea. Rooftop bar or bowling?
photo.story: We've been together 6 years. We need fun, not fancy.

photo.title: Honeymoon: Greek islands or Bali?
photo.story: 2 weeks in June. We've never been to either.

photo.title: Wedding shoes. Heels all night or white sneakers?
photo.story: I'm 5'2 and he's 6'3.

photo.title: Getting married in October. Navy suit or black tux?
photo.story: She said 'whatever you want' which means she has an answer.

photo.title: Spare room: his gaming setup or my reading nook? Who's right?
photo.story: We both work from home. Only one door that closes.

photo.title: Kitchen reno. White cabinets or dark green?
photo.story: My mom says green will be 'dated in 2 years'.

photo.title: Baby sleeps in our room or in the nursery from day one?
photo.story: My mom says nursery. My husband wants the bassinet next to us.

photo.title: First tattoo at 30. Forearm or ankle?
photo.story: I work at a bank. My mom will see either way.

photo.title: Bridal bouquet. All white or wildflowers?
photo.story: Barn wedding in September.

photo.title: Ring shopping with my boyfriend. Oval or emerald cut?
photo.story: He's going to 'surprise' me but wanted my opinion first.

photo.title: Picking our puppy tonight. My husband likes the loud one, I like the sleepy one.
photo.story: Two puppies at the rescue. We can only take one.

photo.title: Cat for my first apartment. Kitten or the senior cat from the shelter?
photo.story: The senior cat is 11 and has been there 8 months.

photo.title: Morgan Wallen concert next week. Cowboy boots or sneakers?
photo.story: We'll be standing for 4 hours.

photo.title: Girls night out. Red lip or nude?
photo.story: First night out since the baby. 8 months.

photo.title: Nails for my wedding. Classic French or milky white?
photo.story: I'll be staring at my ring in every picture.

photo.title: First car for my 17 year old. Old Corolla or a used Jeep?
photo.story: He wants the Jeep so bad. I want him alive.

photo.title: Girls weekend activity. Wine tasting or spa day?
photo.story: 5 of us, one is pregnant.

photo.title: Christmas card photo. Us with the dog or just us?
photo.story: The dog is a 90 lb lab who hates holding still.

photo.title: Moving in together. My queen bed or his full from college? Who's right?
photo.story: His mattress is older than our relationship.

photo.title: His idea of a romantic anniversary dinner vs mine. Who's right?
photo.story: He's not wrong that the wings are amazing.

photo.title: First week at the new job. Blazer or cardigan?
